fields.summary: Web UI 2.0: Egress filter does not appear as egress action in the port config table
fields.description:
# Create a filter egress list and filter
# Associate it to port
# The port table should show the egress filter as a filter action like in CLI:

{noformat}NPB-Ie8# show ports port
Port     Name           Admin    Link    Speed ASpeed Alarms Mode     FEC       Ingress Action         Egress Action
======== ============== ======== ======= ===== ====== ====== ======== ========= ====================== ========================
1                       Enabled  Up        10G    10G No     Normal   Disable
2                       Enabled  Down      10G      0 No     Normal   Disable
3                       Enabled  Down      10G      0 No     Normal   Disable
4                       Enabled  Down       1G      0 No     Normal   Disable                          FILTER
{noformat}

But in fact it doesn’t show it:

!image-20261015-124338.png|width=742,alt="image-20261015-124338.png"!
